summary: This Form 8-K reports Curtiss-Wright Corporation entering into a new $1 billion syndicated revolving credit facility, replacing its existing $750 million facility, with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent. The facility matures May 19, 2031, and is for general corporate purposes, including potential acquisitions. No special situation event; it is a routine refinancing of credit lines, not a change-of-control or restructuring transaction.
